name: Yb14MnSb11
summary: Ca14AlSb11-type Zintl compound with a large, complex unit cell (208 atoms in the conventional cell) and very low lattice thermal conductivity. It is a high-temperature p-type material developed for space power.
caveats: Large cell with Mn 3d / Yb 4f states; database coverage is sparse and DFT results depend strongly on the treatment of correlation.

description.text: Yb14MnSb11 crystallizes in the tetragonal I4_1/acd space group. There are four inequivalent Yb sites. In the first Yb site, Yb(1) is bonded to two equivalent Sb(1), two equivalent Sb(2), and two equivalent Sb(3) atoms to form YbSb6 octahedra that share corners with two equivalent Yb(1)Sb6 octahedra, corners with six equivalent Yb(3)Sb6 octahedra, corners with two equivalent Mn(1)Yb4Sb4 tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent Yb(3)Sb6 octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-54°. Both Yb(1)-Sb(1) bond lengths are 3.28 Å. Both Yb(1)-Sb(2) bond lengths are 3.35 Å. Both Yb(1)-Sb(3) bond lengths are 3.15 Å. In the second Yb site, Yb(2) is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Sb(2), two equivalent Sb(1), and three equivalent Sb(3) atoms. The Yb(2)-Sb(2) bond length is 3.19 Å. There is one shorter (3.18 Å) and one longer (3.39 Å) Yb(2)-Sb(1) bond length. There are a spread of Yb(2)-Sb(3) bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.73 Å. In the third Yb site, Yb(3) is bonded to one Sb(2), one Sb(4), two equivalent Sb(1), and two equivalent Sb(3) atoms to form distorted YbSb6 octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one Yb(3)Sb6 octahedra, corners with three equivalent Yb(1)Sb6 octahedra, corners with two equivalent Mn(1)Yb4Sb4 tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent Yb(3)Sb6 octahedra,  a faceface with one Yb(1)Sb6 octahedra, and  a faceface with one Yb(3)Sb6 octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-54°. The Yb(3)-Sb(2) bond length is 3.23 Å. The Yb(3)-Sb(4) bond length is 3.21 Å. There is one shorter (3.21 Å) and one longer (3.25 Å) Yb(3)-Sb(1) bond length. There is one shorter (3.20 Å) and one longer (3.22 Å) Yb(3)-Sb(3) bond length. In the fourth Yb site, Yb(4) is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Mn(1), one Sb(2), one Sb(4), two equivalent Sb(1), and two equivalent Sb(3) atoms. The Yb(4)-Mn(1) bond length is 3.51 Å. The Yb(4)-Sb(2) bond length is 3.31 Å. The Yb(4)-Sb(4) bond length is 3.45 Å. There is one shorter (3.16 Å) and one longer (3.74 Å) Yb(4)-Sb(1) bond length. There is one shorter (3.19 Å) and one longer (3.28 Å) Yb(4)-Sb(3) bond length. Mn(1) is bonded to four equivalent Yb(4) and four equivalent Sb(1) atoms to form distorted MnYb4Sb4 tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent Yb(1)Sb6 octahedra and corners with eight equivalent Yb(3)Sb6 octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-50°. All Mn(1)-Sb(1) bond lengths are 2.71 Å. There are four inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb(4) is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Yb(3) and four equivalent Yb(4) atoms. In the second Sb site, Sb(1) is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one Yb(1), two equivalent Yb(2), two equivalent Yb(3), two equivalent Yb(4), and one Mn(1) atom. In the third Sb site, Sb(2) is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Yb(1), two equivalent Yb(2), two equivalent Yb(3), and two equivalent Yb(4) atoms. In the fourth Sb site, Sb(3) is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one Yb(1), two equivalent Yb(3), two equivalent Yb(4), and three equivalent Yb(2) atoms.
